newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: SAfrica stocks mixed in record volume,NBS features.
newsitem.headline: SAfrica stocks mixed in record volume,NBS features.

text.p: 1444 GMT - South African industrial shares end firm in record trade on Tuesday boosted by a massive deal in NBS shares.
Volumes traded on the exchange soared to over 2.17 billion rand -- the highest ever in the Johannesburg Stock Exchange's 109-year history, the bourse said.
The financial index also hits a new high at the close gaining 103.6 points to 8,905.2 points.
Dealers say the market which was weaker to flat in the morning received a boost from U.S. first quarter employment and March durable goods orders data.
Volumes thin excluding the NBS transaction in afternoon trade.
Golds depressed by bullion price with index ending at fresh four year lows. Overall market seen strong on Wednesday if Wall Street holds gains to close.
Overall index ends up 34.4 points to 7,106.4, industrials lose 45.4 points to 8,451.4 points and golds lose 29.8 points or 2.4 percent to 1,205.2.
